title: Refined Viz: Fixed Heatmap of Enhanced Trust Adjacency
abstract: Fixed viz of enhanced CSV (eval 277), handling pivot error by fallback to matplotlib heatmap if helper fails, for independent graphing.

original_submission.content:
import os, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ENHANCED_ADJ = "storage/nova/enhanced_trust_adjacency.csv"
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
PNG_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "refined_trust_heatmap.png")

def main():
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(ENHANCED_ADJ)
        pivot = df.pivot(index='source_lineage', columns='target_lineage', values='weighted_trust')
        plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
        plt.imshow(pivot, cmap='Blues')
        plt.colorbar(label='Weighted Trust')
        plt.title("Enhanced Trust Heatmap")
        plt.savefig(PNG_PATH)
        print("REFINED_SAVED", PNG_PATH)
    except Exception as e:
        print("VIZ_ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
